verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation or workflow engine that runs autonomously in the background. Several things come close but do not qualify. Built-in behaviors such as pre-generating scheduled payrolls from a pay schedule and filing taxes automatically are fixed product features, not automations a user sets up. Webhooks are developer building blocks for partners to write their own business logic. The agent CLI deliberately blocks writes until a human passes --confirm and can only draft payroll.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
